qwen_scene_detail.prompt: Describe the visible image in one coherent paragraph of about 80 to 120 words. Describe the setting when visible, the main objects bearing text, their colors and shapes, the placement and arrangement of the writing, and relevant nearby objects or background details. Use concrete spatial relationships. Describe only what is supported by the image; do not infer a named city, an unseen location, the purpose of objects, or a story. Quote text only if clearly readable. For a close-up, describe the visible object instead of inventing a wider scene. Return only the description.

qwen_scene_visual.prompt: Write a detailed visual caption in four to six sentences. Focus on the text-bearing surfaces, the appearance and position of their lettering, colors, shapes and surrounding objects. State only visible facts and avoid guessing text or a named location. Describe a tightly cropped image as a close-up. Return a single natural paragraph.

Two image-only prompts; choose on same development set. No annotation/OCR injection or manual caption rewriting.
